scripts.test: bun run test:repository && bun run test:skills && bun run test:flow && bun run test:komposer
scripts.test:skills: for f in tests/skills/*/*.sh; do bash "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:flow: bun install --cwd fuse/flow --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd fuse/flow test --timeout 60000
scripts.test:komposer: bun install --cwd fuse/komposer --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd fuse/komposer test --timeout 60000
